endorsements.quote: Health systems can operationalize this approach by requiring clinician-authored narrative anchors before note finalization.
Training programs should explicitly teach narrative governance using the DIRECTOR Framework.

unlisted_practices: Clinicians should insert a framing sentence, a risk acknowledgment, and a contingency statement into AI-generated notes as a brief final narrative pass using the DIRECTOR Framework.
Clinicians should confirm that AI-generated notes reflect clinician judgment rather than AI inference (authorship check) before approving them.
Clinicians should remove stigmatizing or opaque language from AI-generated patient-facing notes and ensure they accurately reflect uncertainty.
Health systems should assess narrative quality of clinical notes by the presence of framing, documented risk consideration, and contingency planning.
Clinicians should correct copied-forward content in AI-generated notes and reconcile it with current vital sign trends and nursing notes.

screen.reason: This is an editorial/commentary proposing a framework (the DIRECTOR framework) and operationalizing cinematic storytelling principles for clinicians reviewing and editing ambient AI clinical documentation.
